# Sol implementation brief — issue 111 listening key authority and facilitator packet

## Decision

**SOL XHIGH READINESS PASS / READY FOR SOL HIGH PASS 1 / REAL EXECUTION NOT AUTHORIZED.** Sol High
implements one focused pass; Sol XHigh briefs and verifies. One bounded HOLD correction is the
maximum second pass. A second HOLD is terminal STOP.

The finish line is **AGENT PREPARATION COMPLETE / READY FOR REAL FACILITATOR**, never human
listening completion. Initial Issue-111 preflight/preparation/playback/session/trial/response/reveal/
result counters are `0/0/0/0/0/0/0/0`.

## Frozen input and sole defect

Consume stopped Issue 033, **Issue-007 builtin filter and matrix human listening qualification**,
only as technical input and completed Issue 110, **Complete builtin benchmark host metadata run
from a fresh successor namespace**, as machine authority. Preserve the 16 non-document Issue-033
paths and hashes listed in the spec, `Cargo.lock`, all seven Issue-110 artifacts and absent
`target/issue33` exactly.

The only semantic correction is the missing preparation-to-private-key edge. The old linked
validator accepts preparation/key A with reveal/key B because it never compares the supplied key
SHA-256 with preparation's `assignment_key_sha256` and private packet-member digest. Close that
edge before any qualification can pass. A valid format-only fixture must use one identical key
digest across preparation, packet map and reveal; mismatch in either preparation field rejects.

## Implementation boundary

Create only successor-named `check`, validator, mutation, lifecycle, preflight and preparation
scripts under the exact `*-111` paths in the spec. Use fresh `target/issue111`, successor seal/
disposition identities and clean candidate binding. Reuse the frozen renderer and four schemas
without editing them. Preserve exact render, concealment, response, reveal, statistics and packet
semantics.

The linked qualification path must validate the full preparation, require the regular nlink-1
mode-0600 key at the private packet member, compare its digest to both preparation commitments,
then validate reveal/responses and recompute the exact qualification authorities, counts and
statistics. Reject alternate key path/shape/mode/link, both commitment mismatches, packet drift,
response/reveal drift and authority/count/statistic substitutions.

Fake lifecycle and static mutations must prove successor namespace closure, inherited Issue-033/
110 immutability, zero launch/build where required, no-clobber/second-call refusal, authority
rechecks, partial evidence preservation and exact real counters zero. No source is read and no real
preflight/render/playback/listening action runs during implementation.

## Later authority sequence

After focused PASS and root's clean checkpoint, root may separately arrange a permissioned inbox
and successor preparation seal. Sol XHigh must review before exactly one zero-render preflight.
After another review, root may authorize exactly one machine-only preparation render. There is no
retry, direct/alternate invocation, namespace reuse, playback or human evidence creation.

Only a final Sol XHigh packet audit may record **READY FOR REAL FACILITATOR**. Human identities,
conditions, responses, reveal, sign-offs and qualification remain the real facilitator/listener's
work and cannot be fabricated or closed by agents.

## Paths and gates

Allowed paths are the two Issue-111 docs, six successor `*-111` scripts and minimal exact routing.
Any frozen Issue-033 implementation, product, schema, fixture, Cargo, Issue-110, benchmark, player
or unrelated edit is STOP.

Run only validator format/link tests, hermetic fake lifecycle, static checker/mutations, shell/
Python syntax, frozen identity and docs/diff sanity. A focused PASS authorizes a checkpoint only;
preflight and preparation each require later independent authorization.
